items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Gene Mard, Joe Bazile, Donald Sewell, Bill Cray, and yourself... [INTERVIEWEE] Archie could really sing like Mario Lancia.

ctx.x: Marder. Yeah, I don't know how to spell that either. Gene Mard, Joe Bazile, Donald Sewell, Bill Cray, and yourself, yeah.
Archie could really sing like Mario Lancia. Mm-hmm.
I guess that made the band go over good, huh? Yeah, it did.
